meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对仓库里所有 open issue 和 PR 做只读分析：每个条目开一个后台任务，把每条结论都附 GitHub permalink 证据的报告写进 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录；它不在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或加标签。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等关键词时触发，它接管对 issue 和 PR 的批量只读分析。

say.text: triage 一下这个仓库所有 open issue 和 PR
say.note: 每个条目各开一个后台任务并行分析

say.text: triage PRs，只做分析，不要动 GitHub
say.note: 报告写到 /tmp 的时间戳目录

say.text: triage issues，看看哪些 bug 已有修复提交
say.note: 报告里会附 permalink 证据

howto.what_en: After install, Claude does read-only triage of all open issues and PRs: one background task per item, writing reports (every claim backed by a GitHub permalink) to /tmp/{datetime}/. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", or "triage PRs"; it then takes over the read-only analysis of issues and PRs.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues and PRs in this repo
Triage PRs, analysis only - don't touch GitHub
say_en.note: reports land in a /tmp timestamp dir

say_en.text: Triage issues and check which bugs are already fixed
